name: load_file_alt
note: Loads a disc file (destination, index, table) through the four file tables at 0x80051760; called from the encounter path (0x80020e10). load_file (0x80012d18) is the one most code uses.

name: rand_upto
note: Random number 0..n inclusive; rand_upto(1)==0 is a coin flip. State at 0x80079558 and 0x8007955c (0x20 and 0x24 off $gp = 0x80079538).

name: tim_upload
note: Uploads a TIM (portrait) to VRAM; does nothing if no TIM magic at the source.

name: text_expand
note: Expands a message (names, numbers) into text_buffer 0x8008b400; wraps at 24 codes only for the battle call.

name: text_read_code
note: The printer's reader: dialogue, battle and event text go through it.

name: event_box_print
note: Prints the maze event box (switches, doors, story text).

name: glyph_layer_alloc
note: (size, layer): sets up one of the four glyph sprite layers.

name: glyph_layer_free
note: Frees one glyph layer, or all with -1.

name: glyph_layer_realloc
note: Frees and reallocates one glyph layer.

name: glyph_prepare
note: Before a glyph: reads the font flags at 0x80079705; lays out a sprite from glyph code (size, texture cell).

name: glyph_put
note: (x, y, layer): draws one glyph sprite; a full layer goes to 0x8001f9cc and the glyph is dropped.

name: glyph_put_refused
note: glyph_put's path when the layer is full: the glyph is dropped.

name: event_box_open
note: Opens the maze event box (x, y, rows, columns, ...) and sizes its glyph layer.

name: encounter_load
note: Loads the enemy file for a battle: table 1 index id+0x2c; NPC parties use id 379+n (DATA02/NPTnn.BIN).

name: party_copy_build
note: Rebuilds the party copies (0x80086880) from the roster.

name: return_triangle_draw
note: Draws the separate triangle sprite of the return prompt at a fixed x.

name: help_bar_layer_setup
note: Sizes the help bar's glyph layer (32 sprites).

name: roster
note: Roster records, 0xd0 bytes each, in roster order. Count 20 is inferred (the next known global is 0x8007e810).

name: party_copies
note: Party copy of each character, rebuilt from the roster; records seem 0x90 apart.

name: parties
note: 20 party records of 0x36 bytes.

name: current_party_id
note: Id of the party you are walking with (PartyRec.id).

name: rescue_candidates
note: Indexes of wiped-out parties an NPC party can offer to carry back.

name: rescue_candidate_count
note: Count for rescue_candidates; then the index picked on yes.

name: progress_bits
source: code read 2026-10-10 (MCARD talk handlers); MAZE 0x800a45b0 read 2026-10-11 (C, phase 4)
note: Bit k is set the first time the party enters area tier k (MAZE 0x800a45b0: area 0 bit 1, areas 1-4 bit 2, 5-8 bit 3 ...), so it grows 2, 6, 0xe, 0x1e ... 0x7fe. The rescue offer needs any of bits 1-4, which is true from the first trip into the Grounds.

name: cur_area
note: Current area; written into Roster.area when a party is left in the maze.

name: cur_x
note: Current x.

name: cur_y
note: Current y.

name: cur_facing
note: Current facing.

name: roster_count
note: Number of characters in the roster, recounted by roster_compact (JOUKA 0x800dcb70). Was named party_member_count; the party count is cur_party_count (0x8007e811).

name: talk_script
note: A talk's script, copied here by the builder (0x800c154c).

name: talk_script_pos
note: Halfword index of the next opcode in the running talk script.

name: talk_script_status
note: Set by talk opcodes (1 sets 10, 3 sets 15); -1 when a script block has finished.

name: talk_block
note: Which 30-byte script block runs: 0 main, 1 yes, 2 no (engine-notes said 0x80079be4, a typo).

name: talk_state
note: The talk handlers' state machine (0x28 talk menu, 0x41 offer, 0x42 yes/no, 0x43 reply).

name: yesno_cursor
note: Two-option cursor: 0 = first option (yes).

name: text_buffer
note: Expanded message text; unbounded, live data from 0x8008b640.

name: vwf_widths
note: Variable-width font widths by glyph code (English font).

name: glyph_layers
note: Glyph layer table: start, size per layer.

name: glyph_layer_used
note: Glyph sprites in use, per layer.

name: glyph_total_used
note: Running total of glyph sprites in use.

name: glyph_pool
note: Pointer to the glyph sprite pool.

name: font_flags
note: Font flags read before each glyph (bit 0: ...).

name: config
note: Configuration bytes: Item, Monster, Spell names, Status (0 Japanese, 1 English), sound output, music, effects, SE, then message speed at +8.

name: card_battle_config
note: A card battle packs the eight settings bytes into these bits (+1 is the speed).

name: items_seen
note: 40-byte bitfield: items seen (Boltac's catalog).

name: monsters_seen
note: 60-byte bitfield: monsters seen (Compendium).

name: boltac_stock
note: Boltac's stock, one byte per item.

name: card_parties
note: Card game: 10 parties, 0xc bytes each.

name: unit_cards
note: Card game: 40 Unit Cards, 0x14 bytes each.

name: master_cards
note: Card game: 20 Master Cards, one byte (kind) each; 0xff empty.

name: option_cards
note: Card game: 30 Option Cards, 8 bytes (kind, level, ...); 0xff empty.

name: name_entry_charset
note: Name entry character set: 0 hiragana, 1 katakana, 2 Latin.

name: name_entry_state
note: Name entry state machine, polled every frame.

name: battle_group_monster
note: In battle: the current group's monster record.

name: monster_records
source: docs/engine-notes.md; RAM dump and D code read 2026-10-11
note: Battle monster records, 0xd0 bytes, indexed by group: group g at +g*0xd0 (0 the party slot, 1-4 the monster groups, copied from the last 0xd0 bytes of M_DTnnn.BIN). See types.h Monster.

name: file_table0
note: File table 0 (u16 sector, MSF), to 0x80051a60.

name: file_table1
note: File table 1 (u8; DATA00-03), to 0x80052234.

name: file_table2
note: File table 2 (u8; DATA06), to 0x8005258c.

name: file_table3
note: File table 3 (u8; DATA05), to 0x800526c8.

name: npc_text
note: NPC_MES1-5.OBJ load here when a party is met (shared staging buffer).

name: sisetu_text
note: SISETU.OBJ (town text) loads here.

name: item_names_text
note: I_NAME_E.OBJ / I_NAME_J.OBJ load here.

name: fightmsg_text
note: FIGHTMSG.OBJ, resident.

name: talk_guy
note: Guy's party talk handler (state machine); body recovery fee: all gold.

name: talk_balbo
note: Balbo's party talk handler; body recovery fee: every item.

name: talk_fontana
note: Fontana's party talk handler; body recovery fee: half the gold and items in slots 1,3,5,7,9.

name: talk_script_builder
note: Builds a talk script on the stack (43 blocks of 40 halfwords) and copies it to 0x801ff118; maybe one party's handler.

name: talk_script_run
note: Talk script interpreter: opcode at talk_script_pos, dispatch through talk_opcodes.

name: talk_opcodes
note: 13 handlers for talk opcodes -1..11.

name: talk_op_end
note: Talk opcodes -1 and 4.

name: talk_op0_set_met
note: Opcode 0: sets a met bit (0-19) in Roster.met_bits of each party member.

name: talk_op1
note: Opcode 1: sets talk_script_status = 10.

name: talk_op3
note: Opcode 3 (3 args, inferred: speaker face): sets talk_script_status = 15.

name: talk_op2_print
note: Opcode 2: print NPC string N (-2/-3 insert a character name).

name: talk_op6_portrait
note: Opcode 6 (4 args): loads a portrait.

name: talk_op5
note: Opcode 5.

name: talk_op7_bar_print
note: Opcode 7: print NPC string N in the bottom bar (yes/no questions, topic log lines).

name: talk_op8
note: Opcode 8.

name: talk_op9
note: Opcode 9 (1 arg; follows each healing line, inferred: which cure).

name: talk_op10
note: Opcode 10.

name: talk_op11
note: Opcode 11.

name: bar_print
note: Prints string N in the bottom bar: bar_print(0xa6, 6, N, 1).

name: yesno_read
note: Reads the pad and the yes/no cursor; returns 4 or 2 (inferred: confirm, cancel).

name: talk_script_guy
note: Guy's static talk script (30-byte blocks: main, yes, no ...).

name: talk_script_balbo
note: Balbo's static talk script.

name: talk_script_fontana
note: Fontana's static talk script.

name: balbo_rescue_scan
note: Balbo: scan parties for wiped-out ones (to 0x800c9508).

name: balbo_rescue_fee
note: Balbo: carry the party back (Roster.area = 0xff) and empty every item slot (to 0x800cad64).

name: guy_rescue_fee
note: Guy: carry the party back and take all the gold (to 0x800b7f3c).

name: fontana_rescue_fee
note: Fontana: carry the party back, halve the gold, empty slots 1,3,5,7,9 (to 0x800d24dc).

name: body_search_square
note: Compares candidates' Roster.area/x/y with the current square: the player's own body search.

name: party_leave_in_maze
note: Writes cur_area/x/y/facing into Roster.area..facing for each member (copies at 0x800b0280, 0x800b2250).

name: roster_send_home
note: Sets Roster.area = 0xff for six records and clears 32 bytes at 0x8008c4d0 (a reset or new-party path).

name: config_reset
note: A settings reset: zeroes the language switches (patched to English).

name: config_load_a
note: Copies the settings in from a save.

name: config_load_b
note: Copies the settings in from a save.

name: voicing_merge
note: MCARD's voicing-mark helper (patched off).

name: voicing_merge
note: MAZE's voicing-mark helper (patched off).

name: training_sign_open
note: Opens the training maze sign; resizes glyph layer 0.

name: camp_config_toggles
note: Camp settings screen toggles.

name: config_names
note: Settings names (camp).

name: voicing_merge
note: JOUKA's voicing-mark helper (patched off).

name: town_text_layers
note: Sets up a town screen's four glyph layers through glyph_layer_alloc (720 sprites in all).

name: status_text_layers
note: Status screen (Training Grounds, tavern inspect): sizes its glyph layers.

name: compendium_layout
note: Monster Compendium layout struct (x, y at +4, +6 from centre, width at +8).

name: compendium_draw
note: Compendium code that uses compendium_layout.

name: catalog_layout
note: Boltac's catalog layout struct.

name: catalog_draw
note: Catalog code that uses catalog_layout.

name: item_picture_entry
note: Item picture entry: bit 0x8000 is a tall picture.

name: catalog_desc_y
note: Description y: base + tall x 39.

name: name_entry_cancel
note: Name entry cancel reset.

name: voicing_merge
note: HAZURE's voicing-mark helper (patched off).

name: outskirts_config_toggles
note: Edge of Town settings toggles.

name: config_names
note: Settings names (Edge of Town).

name: name_entry_cancel
note: Name entry cancel reset.

name: voicing_merge
note: BATTLE's voicing-mark helper (patched off).

name: battle_message
note: The battle box's call to text_expand with wrapping on.

name: voicing_merge
note: CMENU's voicing-mark helper (patched off).

name: cmenu_layout
note: Card game menu layout struct.

name: cmain_layout
note: Card battle layout struct.

name: card_config_screen
note: Card battle SELECT settings screen.

name: spinner
note: Settings spinner, given (min, max, step down, step up) on the stack.

name: main
note: Boot, then the main loop: game_mode picks which overlay to load (and clears to 0), game_state picks which overlay routine runs each frame; in talk mode talk_party picks the handler.

name: load_file
note: Loads a disc file: (destination, index, table 0-3). Overlays: table 0 index 172 JOUKA, 173 BATTLE, 174 HAZURE, 175 MCARD, 178 MAZE, all to 0x800a1000. Index 0x28-0x55 in table 0 shifts by 0x3c when bit 0x400 of 0x80079b44 is set.

name: load_overlay_by_name
note: Loads \\NAME.BIN;1 to 0x800a1000 through DsSearchFile and DsRead: the card game overlays CMAIN and CMENU, which the file tables don't cover.

name: card_overlays_swap
note: Loads CMAIN, then CMENU, by name.

name: card_game_enter
note: Game mode 6: loads CMENU by name (the card game).

name: game_mode
note: Set to request an overlay switch, cleared by main: 1 MAZE (from town), 2 BATTLE, 3 JOUKA (town), 4 MAZE (boot), 5 HAZURE, 6 card game, 7 MCARD, 8 catalog/compendium screens then town, 9 talk (MCARD with talk_party).

name: resident_overlay
note: Which overlay is loaded: 1 JOUKA, 2 MAZE, 3 BATTLE, 4 HAZURE, 5 MCARD.

name: game_state
note: Which overlay routine main runs each frame (1, 3, 5, 9, 0x32, 0x33, 0x35 talk ...); per-value meaning to map.

name: talk_party
note: Talk handler index in game state 0x35: 0 Guy (0x800b5694), 1 Balbo (0x800c7264), 2 Fontana (0x800cf8c0), 3 0x800d65c8, 4 0x800d9b34, 6-0x17 more; also indexes a name table at 0x8005e5c8 (portrait file).
